description: Starts a fork of a spec a member published: a spec of the signed-in person's own that begins as a copy and names the first one under lineage.forkedFrom. It returns the fork's spekkr.json, its files and keepFrom, ready to give to publish_spec, and the source's license when it states one. Nothing is published. Change what the person wants changed, then call publish_spec: Spekkr copies every kept file itself, so nothing is downloaded or uploaded. This tool needs sign-in.

id.description: The id of the spec to fork, like username/name. It has to be listed now.

name.description: The fork's name, the part after the slash: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Left out, the fork takes the source's name, with a number added when the person already has a spec of that name.

name: fork_spec
title: Fork a spec
